articles.title: NASA Moon Mission Spacesuit Nears Milestone
articles.summary: The next-generation spacesuit for NASA’s Artemis III mission continues to advance by passing a contractor-led technical review, as the agency prepares to send humans to the Moon’s South Pole for the first time. Testing is also underway for the new suits, built by Axiom Space, with NASA astronauts and spacesuit engineers recently simulating surface operations and tasks […]

articles.title: Liftoff power: launch of first Ariane 6 with four boosters
articles.summary: At 16:45 GMT/17:45 CET the first Ariane 6 rocket with four boosters lifted off from Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana on 12 February, taking 32 Amazon Leo satellites to orbit.

articles.title: USSF-87 Anomaly Reveals Continuing Obstacles for ULA’s Vulcan-Centaur
articles.summary: A familiar anomaly encountered during Vulcan's launch of USSF-87 raises significant concerns for the vehicle’s immediate future.

articles.title: Shimmering Light in Egg Nebula
